source.author: verg
source.text: Iamque arva tenebant ultima, quae bello clari secreta frequentant.
source.text_original: Iamque arva tenebant / ultima, quae bello clari secreta frequentant.
source.text_english: And now they occupied the farthest fields, which, renowned for war, they frequented in seclusion.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_original: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum / secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_english: Go, you are mine; already the dutiful band of the silent summons you to the groves, and Father Aeolus, flying about, calls you to the hidden fields.
